svg.title: Figure HM-4. Hazardous materials shipping paper
svg.desc: Required entries and carriage rules from CA Commercial Driver Handbook DL 650 (REV 12/2019) Section 9 (shipping papers, p. 9-18 to 9-19) and 49 CFR 177.817 / 172.200–172.204. Sample product names are illustrations only.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure HM-4. Hazardous materials shipping paper

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Hazardous materials shipping paper — required entries and where the driver must keep it (DL 650 §9).

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: SHIPPING PAPER (example layout)

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Proper shipping name — Gasoline

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Hazard class / division — 3 (Flammable liquid)

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Identification number — UN1203

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Packing group — II

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Total quantity — 8,000 gallons

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Shipper’s certification and signature

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Emergency response telephone number

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: If needed: RQ, marine pollutant, additional descriptions

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Entries must be printed or legible. Highlight or list HM first.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: WHERE THE DRIVER KEEPS IT

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: While you are driving (belted):

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: In a pouch on the driver’s door, or clearly visible

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: and within immediate reach while you are restrained

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: by a seat belt. (Handbook p. 9-18.)

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: When you leave the cab:

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Leave the papers in the driver’s door pouch or on

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: the driver’s seat. (Handbook p. 9-18.)

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Do not put them in a locked or hidden place

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: where responders cannot find them quickly.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Carriers must require papers to be readily available

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: in an emergency. Emergency information must also

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: work with the Emergency Response Guidebook (ERG).

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Required entries and carriage rules from CA Commercial Driver Handbook DL 650 (REV 12/2019) Section 9 (shipping papers, p. 9-18 to 9-19) and 49 CFR 177.817 / 172.200–172.204. Sample product names are illustrations only.
